purpose: Separate teacher instability from stable typicality/importance mismatch
Diagnose window-dependent scores and distinguish score compression from rank changes
Screen cheap supervised objectives and whole-video statistics before a same-Qwen controlled comparison

teachers.baseline: Original frozen R0; reproduce q/raw before controls

train_self_exclusion.singleton_fallback: Record explicitly; use train-global peers only if needed

cases.rule: Sort by signed (mean percentile over all 9 teacher versions minus human mean-importance percentile), decreasing absolute directional gap, tie video_id then clip index. Select all top 3 per direction, no deletion.
cases.stability_definition: Teacher q standard deviation <=0.10 and each family mean (original/KM/full/prototype) on same >=0.75 or <=0.25 side; human percentile on opposite <=0.25 or >=0.75 side. These cutoffs classify cases; they do not select model parameters.
cases.human_disagreement: Per-user clip-average importance distribution, per-user whole-video importance percentile distribution, and fraction above own native-frame median
cases.frames: Exact four cached sampled inputs per selected clip, SHA verified; view images before content interpretation

metrics: pseudo MSE and weighted pair agreement
score dispersion/ties and calibrated reward decomposition
same-clip cross-window range/std, within-clip position and context association

window_offset.fit: Shared-clip predicted scores only; zero-mean component gauge via ridge; no q/human access

students.architecture: Fixed random projection to 512 (not learned), shared 512->64 GELU ->1 sigmoid MLP; 32897 trainable parameters in every run
students.input_features: clip CLIP512 + window CLIP mean512 + within-window position1; global view additionally full-video CLIP mean512/std512, zeroed after normalization in local view. No absolute/global time position or video ID.
students.capacity_control: Same frozen random projection and all trainable dimensions active in both views; train-only scaling fitted separately for projected view. Additional global information explicitly disclosed.
students.normalization_fit: Training-feature/pool inputs only; no development feature fitting or human labels
students.human_metrics: Only after all 12 training runs end, evaluate every pre-fixed saved prediction step; final step256 primary, no endpoint selection
students.scope: Different backbone and features from Qwen; cannot claim supervised Qwen substitutes GRPO

optional_input_counterfactual.gate: Run only if original S0 mean shared-clip range>=0.05 and overlap-offset correction reduces it by>=20%; compute gate from cached predictions only, no human AP
optional_input_counterfactual.checkpoint: Same frozen common merged S0, no adapter update
optional_input_counterfactual.video_selection: Fixed rng42 chooses four sorted development IDs before any new-round human evaluation; two adjacent center windows each
conditions: B: original overview plus duplicate original overview
C: original overview plus 16 complementary cached global frames in same-layout second overview
optional_input_counterfactual.primary_comparison: B vs C: identical text/placeholders, local frames, image sizes, image token budget, weights, greedy decoder and score aggregation; only second overview image content changes. A is replay/cost reference.
record: actual processed image/video frame grids and visual tokens
shared-clip consistency and pseudo-fit; no tuning

evaluation.primary: Registered V0 stable interval mapper, then fixed decimal12 tie canonicalization for every old/new score
evaluation.sensitivity: Also report unrounded stable metrics; preserve original first-round reports
evaluation.binary: Per annotator native-frame strict above own median; noninterpolated tied AP; no-positive=0; user then video mean
evaluation.resampling_unit: Registered video/source, 10000 bootstrap draws seed42; no frame/window independent-sample claims
evaluation.seed_reporting: All three student initializations; summarize paired per-video differences averaged over seeds and separately report seed spread; not n=30 independent sources
evaluation.multiple_comparisons: Descriptive diagnostic, no confirmatory discovery or selection of largest AP
evaluation.new_variants: Any additional attempts explicitly logged, never silently omit

changes: Separate fixed-embedding KMeans from full UMAP/KMeans sensitivity
Factor self-exclusion independently from video weighting
Use same real active model capacity through fixed projection; remove global time from local view
Use two clean objectives and 12 runs; exclude raw-score+percentile objective which changes target and postprocessing together
Verify draft stable mapper against registered implementation before reuse
Conditional true input experiment has matched duplicate-image token control
